연구 및 기술

Google팀은 복잡한 과제를 풀고, AI를 발전시키고, 최대한 많은 사람에게 도움이 되고자 노력합니다.

Google DeepMind

Google 연구팀

Google Labs

Google for Developers

Google Cloud

"Google은 앞으로도 기대감을 가지고 AI가 제시하는 기회에 과감하게 접근할 것입니다. 그러면서도 이 모든 과정을 책임감 있게 진행하겠습니다.”

선다 피차이, Google 및 Alphabet CEO

Google CEO의 메시지 읽어보기

Google이 이러한 노력을 기울이는 이유

Google은 모두를 위한 기술을 구축한다는 열정으로 모든 일에 임하고 있습니다.

Google의 이야기

차고에서 시작해 Googleplex에 오기까지 Google이 지나온 여정을 돌아 보세요.

공공 정책

Google은 안전하면서도 회복탄력성 있는 디지털 미래를 만들기 위해 정부, 기업, 지역사회와 협력하고 있습니다.

사회적 영향력

Google이 심각한 사회 문제 해결을 돕기 위해 AI를 활용하는 방식을 알아보세요.

약속

이용자 보호, 기회 확대 등 Google의 가치와 우선순위에 관해 자세히 알아보세요.

Grow with Google

기술과 경력 또는 비즈니스 구축에 도움이 되는 교육 프로그램과 리소스를 찾아보세요.

시작하기

공익사업과 이니셔티브

지속 가능성, 접근성, 지역사회 참여를 위한 Google의 노력을 자세히 살펴보세요.

지속 가능성

더 지속 가능한 미래로 나아가기 위한 Google의 노력에 관해 알아보세요.

Google.org

Google은 지원이 필요한 지역사회를 돕고 모두를 위한 기회를 확대하기 위해 자금과 전문 기술 지식을 제공하고 있습니다.

접근성

Google은 장애인이 사용하기 더욱 편리한 제품을 만들기 위해 장애인과 함께 일하고 있습니다.

Google DeepMind

Google Onderzoek

Google Labs

Google voor ontwikkelaars

Google Cloud

"AI is een spannende ontwikkeling die we vol enthousiasme blijven omarmen. Natuurlijk wel op een verantwoorde manier."

Sundar Pichai, CEO van Google en Alphabet

Meer van onze CEO

Waarom we doen wat we doen

We laten ons altijd leiden door onze passie voor technologie waar iedereen baat bij heeft.

Ons verhaal

Ontdek de geschiedenis van Google, van de garage tot het Googleplex.

Openbaar beleid

We streven ernaar om samen met overheden, bedrijven en community's te werken aan een veilige en veerkrachtige digitale toekomst.

Sociale impact

Ontdek hoe we aan de hand van AI de grootste uitdagingen in de maatschappij oplossen.

Beloftes

Ontdek meer over onze waarden en prioriteiten, van het beschermen van gebruikers tot het uitbreiden van de mogelijkheden.

Groei met Google

Zoek trainingen en bronnen om je vaardigheden, loopbaan of bedrijf verder te ontwikkelen.

Aan de slag

Outreach en initiatieven

Ga dieper in op onze inspanningen op het gebied van duurzaamheid, toegankelijkheid en betrokkenheid bij de community.

Duurzaamheid

Krijg meer informatie over onze activiteiten om een duurzamere toekomst op te bouwen.

Google.org

We bieden financiering en technische expertise voor community's met beperkte middelen, om iedereen meer kansen te geven.

Toegankelijkheid

We ontwikkelen meer toegankelijke producten met en voor personen met beperkingen.

Relaties met Alphabet-investeerders

Raadpleeg onze meest recente inkomstenrapporten en andere updates.

News

I/O 2026: Welcome to the agentic Gemini era

Google CEO Sundar Pichai shares how we’re helping you get more done with Gemini.

Read more

Our latest models

Introducing Gemini Omni

Gemini Omni Flash is a model that can create anything from any input — starting with video.

Gemini 3.5: frontier intelligence with action

We’re kicking off the series by releasing 3.5 Flash, delivering frontier performance for agents and coding.

New, helpful agents and tools

The Gemini app becomes even more helpful

Updates include a new design language, proactive Daily Brief and a 24/7 personal agent called Gemini Spark.

More ways to help you shop

We’re introducing the Universal Cart, a truly intelligent shopping cart and your new hub for shopping on Google.

Create and get things done in Workspace

Discover conversational voice features in Gmail, Docs and Keep, a tool called Google Pics, updates to AI Inbox and more.

A new era for AI Search

Learn what the latest Search capabilities mean for you — from a new intelligent Search box to AI agents.

More highlights

Build anything, ship everywhere with Google AI Studio

Coming to Google AI Studio: native Android vibe coding, Google Workspace integrations, a mobile app and more.

Intelligent eyewear coming this fall

Get directions, send texts, snap photos and more — all without taking out your phone.

Expanded content transparency and verification tools

We're making it easier to understand how content was created and edited across the web.
